summary: This plugin performs Git workspace pre-flight checks, reporting branch and remote sync state, commit author identity source, staged versus unstaged changes, and duplicate checkouts to help you decide whether it is safe to continue.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is a repository-analysis utility for Git workspaces, whose primary purpose is pre-flight safety inspection before writes, commits, or pushes. Evidence in the README and package metadata shows tools that inspect branch state, upstream drift, fetch freshness, identity origin, staged/untracked changes, and duplicate checkouts to decide whether further work is safe, while emphasizing read-only default behavior and explicit optional fetching. This is best classified as project-analysis rather than code generation, media, UI, or external service integration.
